tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Pale oxide-stone by day, blackened steel by night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks and anything lifted off the page.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never carries text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, captions and secondary text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Links and primary buttons. A deep rust that passes 4.5:1 as text on surface.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an action fill.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Fresh rust orange, the fence at its brightest. Large decorative blocks and rules only, not small text.

tokens.name: rust-deep
tokens.usage: Text in the rust family, on rust-tint, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: rust-tint
tokens.usage: Tag and callout background; pair with rust-deep text.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Weathered steel and shadow brown. Large decorative blocks and heavy rules; never behind small text in the dark theme.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Sunlit granite from the photo. Decorative blocks and highlights; never behind light text.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Prickly pear green. Decorative accent, not small text.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Text in the green family, on sage-tint, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: sage-tint
tokens.usage: Tag and callout background; pair with pine text.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Desert sky. Decorative accent, used sparingly.

tokens.name: sky-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet background for notes; pair with ink text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home page title and post titles on a post page.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: The light came in low and turned the boulders gold.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Most of what I write here starts as a walk.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, reading time and image captions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control; rail spacing on the cover.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between tags; small card gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; button padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; paragraph rhythm.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top of a page, above the title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and color blocks. Square, like cut steel.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and images.
